text:
alex: heads-up: the deploys handbook page on staging has a dead iframe embed for the CLI snippet (looks like external host removed it). hitting https://staging.redwood.ai/handbook/deploys#cli-sample -> iframe 404. who can grab a quick fix?

taylor: I can patch this in a bit. do we want to rehost the file under our internal /kb/snippets or just inline the code?

ram: inline is better for tiny CLI examples (less flaky). plus we get better linting in CI if it's codeblock.

alex: agree inline is fine here, it's only ~5 lines. also the anchor got renamed last month so we might need to update the fragment.

docs-bot: automated link scan: handbook/deploys.md -> external embed 404 (checked 2026-03-22). Suggested: replace with fenced code block + short provenance note.

taylor: plan: copy snippet into inline fenced block, update anchor to `#cli-quickstart`, add a one-liner note in the PR body about original source. will open PR within the hour.

taylor: snippet to paste: 

```bash
# create API key
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/auth \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"api_key":"$REDWOOD_KEY"}'
```

julia: quick ask: can you also run the docs lint locally? last time we had a stray trailing space that broke the preview.

taylor: yep running `make docs-lint` before I push.

taylor: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4182 — replaces iframe with inline snippet, fixes anchor, adds lint test and a changelog entry. reviewers: @julia @ram

ci-bot: preview build queued. will post staging link when ready.

ci-bot: staging preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/handbook/deploys#cli-quickstart (build 2026-03-22-1018).

julia: glanced — tiny nit in frontmatter I left a comment on. otherwise lgtm.

ram: approved and merged. thanks for handling quickly.

alex: great, appreciate the quick turnaround :smile: closing out.
